author: The Digital Foundry
description: Welcome to The Digital Foundry Podcast, hosted by Jared Chandler, co-owner and entrepreneur. Inside our audio experience, you’ll get a variety of guests picked from all over the world, each representing different industries. Every episode is packed with information on marketing, business, as well as upcoming trends. This is the perfect podcast for business owners and managers to learn about marketing from top talent in global companies.
